entries.message: Fix - Stop duplicate release image builds and add GHCR tag cleanup
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Fixed the release pipeline building and pushing the Docker image to GHCR twice per push to main; only the final job (which runs against the already-committed changelog/version bump) now builds and publishes it

Added a weekly scheduled workflow that prunes old numbered develop-* and alpha-* image tags (keeping the newest 15 of each) and deletes dangling untagged images left behind when the latest/develop/alpha tags move
The cleanup workflow starts in dry-run mode so nothing is deleted until a run has been reviewed
